summary.question: can the reduced skin hidden address reject c, the tile the local rule wrongly admits?
summary.declared_outcome_class: D. Split -- the class changes along the ladder (narrow half-widths ADMIT, wide/undefined), and c never changes F at the scar, so there is no REJECT at any scale
summary.plain: The window reader never rejects c at the scar (F(W+c) = F(W) at every scale and both conventions); narrow windows ADMIT, wide windows are UNDEFINED; restoring the witness tile does not change this; the only rejections of c occur in windows far from the scar. The shed reason is not recoverable by this window reader.
